pages.title: [POLICY] Release readiness operations
pages.content:
# Release readiness operations

Evaluate required changes first, then blockers, then security approval. Publish the first failed gate as `READINESS <release>: BLOCKED - <reason>.` Comment once on the marked release record but do not transition a BLOCKED record. Before writing, reconcile tracker and channel state independently: if the exact status already exists, do not repost it; add only a missing tracker comment. Never duplicate a status.
